title: Default assets on maps that uses parallax mapping

posts.author: caratulin_porotin
posts.body: Hello! what do you guys think about the use of default assets + parallax mapping?? I am thinking on incorporating it into my game, everything else is customized, i just dont like working on maps

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Anyone using default assets anywhere deserves to be flayed.
Jokes aside, do whatever the heck you want with your game, your description doesn't mean anything. What kind of parallax? What kind of map? Like you actually make maps in parallax? Or you mapping in engine and adding parallax as shadows? There are many ways to do maps.

posts.body:

Click to expand...
I don't mind them at all. And I don't see why people think everything needs to be customized if there's game focuses more on story or mechanic.Wise it's usually not even much of a bother! Also I enjoy my default assets very much; to the point that I only like using customized items if they look very close to "vanilla" assets.
And there isn't any other way to get better at mapping if you're not mapping at all- unfortunately.

posts.author: TRIDIUM
posts.body:
Parallax mapping is a
method
, not a style. Whether the RTP (I assume you're using the MV chibi style characters) looks good with your custom assets.
Most parallax maps I see are very detailed, have more muted colors, and advanced shading, so I would say no, they don't go well with the cartoony and chibi default assets.

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: Made this in my game and I like the result. I personally don't think defaults asets are wrong, not at all, just make a good use of them and will be fine!

posts.author: ophanimkei
posts.body:
I think it depends. I just think that if you're going to use parallax mapping with default assets, you can also use things like color mapping / filters to make things look a bit prettier. Flesh Blood and Concrete is a lovely RPG Maker game that uses a lot of default assets along with parallax mapping, and it looks beautiful. Also, I remember when learning how to work with parallax maps that I followed
Lorelai's
tutorials, and her maps are really lovely despite using default assets.
